- [Bank reconciliation](/work/workspace/deliverable/bank_reconciliation.md)
- [Adjusting entries](/work/workspace/deliverable/adjusting_entries.json)
- [Adjusted trial balance](/work/workspace/deliverable/trial_balance_2026-03-31.json)
- [Open items for Ray and the lender](/work/workspace/deliverable/open_items.md)
- [Status](/work/workspace/deliverable/STATUS.md)

The main unresolved item is the **$59,188 difference** between GL A/R and the supplied aging. The unidentified **$4,312 deposit** is recorded in suspense, as Ray requested. Both are disclosed in the open-items note; neither was cleared with an unsupported entry.
